name: k8s-controller
description: kubeadm control plane plus Cilium 1.20.1 (kube-proxy replacement), airgap-capable.

config.raw.lxc:
lxc.apparmor.profile=unconfined
lxc.cap.drop=
lxc.cgroup.devices.allow=a
lxc.mount.auto=proc:rw sys:rw cgroup:rw

parameters.name: cpu_cores
parameters.description: LXD limits.cpu. Integer cores; must be >= resources.cpu_cores.min.

parameters.name: memory
parameters.description: LXD limits.memory (hard, no swap). IEC units only; must be >= resources.memory.min.

parameters.name: root_disk_size
parameters.description: Root disk size for the instance device. IEC units only; must be >= resources.root_disk.min.

parameters.name: storage_pool
parameters.description: LXD storage pool holding the root disk.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Guest hostname and Kubernetes node name. Per instance; never assumed fixed.

parameters.name: instance_name
parameters.description: LXD instance name. Per instance, so a worker and controller can share a hypervisor.

parameters.name: static_ip
parameters.description: Static IPv4 CIDR for eth0, e.g. 192.168.8.41/24.

parameters.name: gateway
parameters.description: Default gateway IPv4. No default; supplied by the operator.

parameters.name: dns_servers
parameters.description: Comma-separated DNS server IPv4 list. Whitespace around entries is stripped; each entry must be a valid IPv4 address.

parameters.name: apiserver_advertise_address
parameters.description: IPv4 the kube-apiserver binds and advertises (this instance's address).

parameters.name: control_plane_endpoint
parameters.description: host:port written into kubeadm as the control-plane endpoint and used as Cilium k8sServiceHost. Must be an address reachable from every node (controller IP or an operator-provided LB/VIP).

parameters.name: bridge
parameters.description: Host bridge the NIC attaches to.

parameters.name: image_alias
parameters.description: LXD image alias or fingerprint.

parameters.name: allow_privileged
parameters.description: Explicit opt-in for security.privileged and the unconfined AppArmor raw.lxc. Renders fail without true.

parameters.name: apt_mirror
parameters.description: Ubuntu archive mirror base URL (deb822 URIs).

parameters.name: k8s_apt_repo
parameters.description: Kubernetes apt repo for the minor line, e.g. <mirror>/core:/stable:/v1.35/deb/.

parameters.name: k8s_apt_key_url
parameters.description: URL of the armored Kubernetes apt signing key on the mirror.

parameters.name: k8s_apt_key_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of the armored key file.

parameters.name: k8s_version
parameters.description: Expected kubeadm version; bootstrap fails if the installed binary differs.

parameters.name: k8s_package_version
parameters.description: Exact apt version for kubelet, kubeadm, kubectl. Verify against the mirror before release.

parameters.name: containerd_package_version
parameters.description: Exact Ubuntu archive apt version for containerd (no default; must be read from the mirror).

parameters.name: registry_mirror
parameters.description: Pull-through/mirror registry URL. Must serve upstream repository paths (registry.k8s.io/..., quay.io/cilium/...).

parameters.name: mirrored_registries
parameters.description: Upstream registries routed through registry_mirror by containerd hosts.toml.

parameters.name: internal_ca_url
parameters.description: Optional PEM CA for a private mirror TLS chain. Empty skips.

parameters.name: internal_ca_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of internal_ca_url content. Required when internal_ca_url is set.

parameters.name: pod_cidr
parameters.description: Pod CIDR. Avoid 192.168.0.0/16 (overlaps common LANs).

parameters.name: service_cidr
parameters.description: Service CIDR.

parameters.name: chart_mirror_url
parameters.description: Base URL of the Helm chart file mirror; chart fetched as <base>/cilium-<cilium_version>.tgz.

parameters.name: cilium_version
parameters.description: Cilium chart and image version. 1.20.1 is the version verified in the runbook.

parameters.name: cilium_chart_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of the Cilium chart tgz.

parameters.name: cilium_crds_url
parameters.description: URL of the Cilium CRD bundle (single multi-document YAML built by tools/build-cilium-crd-bundle.sh) on the operator mirror. Chart tgz has no CRDs.

parameters.name: cilium_crds_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of the Cilium CRD bundle.

parameters.name: cilium_cli_url
parameters.description: URL of the pinned cilium-cli linux-amd64 tarball on the mirror.

parameters.name: cilium_cli_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of the cilium-cli tarball.

parameters.name: join_token_ttl
parameters.description: TTL for the bootstrap join token minted for workers.

parameters.name: report_mode
parameters.description: hub: POST join material to report_url with a bearer. local: write /var/lib/gough/biome-report.json (+ .done marker) for the hypervisor installer to pull. Empty infers hub when report_url is set, otherwise local.

parameters.name: report_url
parameters.description: hub mode only: https endpoint receiving join material. Must be empty in local mode.

parameters.name: report_bootstrap_token
parameters.description: hub mode only: one-time bearer for the join-material report. Secret. Must be empty in local mode.

parameters.name: kube_proxy_replacement
parameters.description: ORCHESTRATOR DECISION: false (default) keeps kube-proxy with conntrack zeroed via KubeProxyConfiguration (runbook-verified path). true switches to Cilium kubeProxyReplacement and skips the kube-proxy addon.

parameters.name: cilium_gateway_api
parameters.description: Enable Cilium Gateway API. Requires gateway_api_crds_url and gateway_api_crds_sha256 (CRDs come from the chart/file mirror). Default false.

parameters.name: cilium_hubble
parameters.description: Enable Hubble and Hubble relay. Default false (runbook: optional observability).

parameters.name: gateway_api_crds_url
parameters.description: URL of the Gateway API standard-install CRD manifest on the chart/file mirror. Required (non-empty) when cilium_gateway_api is true.

parameters.name: gateway_api_crds_sha256
parameters.description: sha256 of the Gateway API CRD manifest. Required when cilium_gateway_api is true.

parameters.name: allow_insecure_mirrors
parameters.description: Allow plain http:// for mirror URLs (airgapped labs). Logged as a warning. Default false; report_url is always https.

parameters.name: allow_registry_fallback
parameters.description: Add the public upstream (e.g. registry-1.docker.io) as a containerd fallback behind registry_mirror. Default false: mirror-only, so airgapped nodes never dial public registries.
